title: Outlook for Mac: Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap plan and distinguishes existing email DLP controls from unconfirmed calendar behaviour. The Purview path stops at policy creation rather than the scope and simulation controls, and Microsoft's broader support matrix qualifies the dedicated email reference's support statement.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has not yet described this Outlook for Mac calendar DLP capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook for Mac calendar DLP 569717; Outlook for Mac calendar data loss prevention licensing. Opened mobile policy-tip reference, deployment guidance and Mac preferences; searched release-note excerpts. No calendar DLP description found.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; controls[0].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: The dedicated Learn reference documents DLP policy tips for email in Outlook for Android, iOS and macOS.
claims.quote: Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS now supports data loss prevention (DLP) policy tips with commonly used predicates and exceptions, advanced classifiers, and override capabilities.

claims.claim: Microsoft's troubleshooting article says policy tips are not supported for Outlook for Mac iOS clients, conflicting with the dedicated reference.
claims.quote: Policy tips are currently not supported for Outlook for Mac iOS clients.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Email Policy Tip UI is off by default in Outlook for Android, iOS and macOS.
claims.quote: Policy Tip UI is turned off by default in Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS to allow for administrators to test and perform user training prior to deployment.

claims.claim: The email policy-tip setting is named Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook and is enabled in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook | (default) Disabled policy tips aren't shown Enabled policy tips are shown

claims.claim: Customization > Policy Management > Create > Configure Settings > Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook reaches the email setting in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. On the Policy configurations page, select Create. ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.

claims.claim: Configuration creation asks for its name and scope before Configure Settings.
claims.quote: On the Start with the basics page, enter a name (required) ... On the Choose the scope page, determine whether the policy configuration applies to all users, specific groups, or to users who anonymously access documents using Office for the web.

claims.claim: The email policy-tip control can be targeted to individuals or groups within the organisation.
claims.quote: You can target policies to individuals or groups, so you can test and deploy policy tip UI as needed through your organization.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API to configure this Microsoft 365 Apps admin center policy-tip switch as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Cloud Policy service Microsoft 365 Apps policy configuration API PowerShell Graph Enable Purview DLP policy tips Outlook; Cloud Policy API policy configuration Microsoft 365. Read Cloud Policy overview and API audit-schema excerpts; no configuration operation found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing

claims.where: summary; front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A calendar-specific DLP licence requirement has not yet been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook for Mac calendar data loss prevention licensing; Outlook calendar events DLP licensing price meter Copilot Credits. Read Purview service description, mobile and Outlook for Microsoft 365 policy-tip references and deployment guidance; no calendar-specific entitlement found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a price specific to DLP on Outlook for Mac calendar events.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook calendar events DLP licensing price meter Copilot Credits. Opened Purview service description and DLP references; no calendar-specific price found. Search results for Copilot billing describe other services.

claims.claim: No feature-specific meter, including Copilot Credits or pay-as-you-go, is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook calendar events DLP licensing price meter Copilot Credits. Read Purview service description and DLP references; search billing excerpts concern agents and other Copilot services, not Outlook calendar DLP.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included, based on the named general Exchange Online DLP entitlement, with calendar-specific details left open.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive for Business ... Which licenses provide the rights for a user to benefit from the service? ... Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5/E3/A3/G3

claims.claim: Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy opens policy creation in the Microsoft Purview portal for configuring scope and policy state.
claims.quote: Open the Data loss prevention solution and go to Policies > + Create policy. ... Choose where to apply the policy. Select only the Exchange email location. ... Select Next, then select Run the policy in simulation mode.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and the rendered path to 'Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Custom > Custom > Choose where to apply the policy > Exchange email > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > Run the policy in simulation mode'. The cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-cc-email supplies these steps; configure and save the desired rule between Create rule and the policy-state choice.

claims.claim: The cited Exchange email scenario selects Enterprise applications & devices, Custom category, Custom regulation, Exchange email, and simulation after defining rules.
claims.quote: Select Enterprise applications & devices. Select Custom from the Categories list. Select Custom from the Regulations list. ... Select only the Exchange email location. ... Select Next, then select Run the policy in simulation mode.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <policy name> -ExchangeLocation All -Mode <PolicyMode> creates an Exchange-scoped DLP policy with the selected action and notification mode.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies ... The valid value for this parameter is All. ... The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the DLP policy.

claims.claim: The ExchangeLocation parameter does not accept a mailbox list.
claims.quote: The ExchangeLocation parameter specifies whether to include email messages in the DLP policy. The valid value for this parameter is All.

claims.claim: General DLP deployment states include simulation, simulation with policy tips, on and off.
claims.quote: Run the policy in simulation mode ... Run the policy in simulation mode and show policy tips while in simulation mode ... Turn it on right away ... Keep it off

claims.claim: General DLP policies support location scope and inclusion or exclusion of mailbox instances within the tenant.
claims.quote: You can further refine which instances of the location (such as sites, groups, accounts, distribution groups, mailboxes, and devices) that the policy is applied to by configuring the include/exclude options for the location.

claims.claim: Learn recommends simulation with policy tips scoped to a pilot group before full enforcement.
claims.quote: Change the state to Run the policy in simulation mode and show policy tips. Refine the scope of locations to support a pilot group ... Change the state to Turn it on right away. The policy is fully deployed.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed how the general Exchange DLP policy control governs this calendar capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook Mac calendar DLP meeting invitations ExchangeLocation targeting rollout. Read roadmap, New-DlpCompliancePolicy, deployment guidance and mobile reference; the command describes email messages and no passage explains calendar scope.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the Outlook for Mac builds or release channels covered by this calendar capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook for Mac calendar DLP default policy actions permissions release channel. Read roadmap, mobile reference, Mac preferences and release-note search excerpts; no calendar DLP build or channel requirement found.

claims.claim: The dedicated mobile/macOS Learn reference says all actions and information types for email communications are supported.
claims.quote: All actions and information types for email communications are supported.
claims.fix: After the quoted support statement, add: 'Microsoft's broader DLP policy-tip support matrix instead describes Outlook Mac support as a subset, varying by version and licence.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-policy-tips-reference#support-matrix-for-dlp-policy-tips-across-microsoft-apps, whose Outlook Mac row says 'Varies by version and license' and 'Subset', and add that URL to sources.

claims.claim: Learn's Outlook policy-tip and DLP deployment guidance direct readers to Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans and Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions for licensing.
claims.quote: SKU/subscriptions licensing: For information on licensing, see Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans; Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions
